data.rationale: The proposal gets the right sequence (IMDb, then Rotten Tomatoes, then a mail draft with the same subject and body templates), but it lists director, runtime, rating and score as input parameters when they are looked up, it uses a recipient email where the true input is a friend name, and it ends with "Discard/Send" when the true workflow says to click Discard and never Send, which makes it risky to automate as written.
